source.name: Swift Swim
source.originalDescription: When the Pokémon uses a move, their movement speed increases by 30% for 3s. Each time this Pokémon knocks out an opposing Pokémon, scores a goal, or otherwise makes a contribution in battle, their effort gauge increases. Once the gauge is full, the Pokémon evolves into Gyarados.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Swift Swim は スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、KOまたはアシストで発動する。

source.name: Dragon Current
source.originalDescription: Becomes untargetable and dives underwater for up to 4s while this Unite Move is held, increasing movement speed by 45%. When the button is released, the user leaps up forcefully and attacks. If the user stays underwater for 1s, Gyarados strengthens the movement speed increase to 55% and creates a whirlpool when surfacing, applying a continuous slow to opposing Pokémon hit. If the user stays underwater for 2s, Gyarados strengthens the movement speed increase to 65% and creates a waterspout when surfacing, throwing opposing Pokémon hit for 1s. The longer the move is held, the larger the area of effect becomes. After using this Unite Move, the user Mega Evolves for 15 seconds. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Dragon Current は 相手を打ち上げる、移動速度を下げる、対象指定されない、またはステルス状態になる、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる。
